title: Automatic reminders show 'on' but the owner cannot see which members will really get them
what: The automatic reminders screen shows only how many reminder types are switched on. A member gets a reminder only if they have the app, matched their number at a QR check-in, their first name matches, the number is not shared, notifications are allowed, and (for birthday, welcome, one year, we haven't seen you) the date is filled in. None of this is shown per member or as a count, so the owner cannot tell that most members may get nothing.
expected: Next to each reminder, a count such as 'reaches 6 of 40 members', and per member why not (no app, not checked in, no date of birth).
how_often: every gym with reminders on; real reach on Crispy Curves not counted (no database query in this step)
fix_line: Show each reminder's real reach and the reasons members are left out

title: No record that an automatic reminder ever went to anyone
what: Members' phones set the automatic reminders themselves. Nothing is reported back, so neither the owner nor HQ can open a list of who got a birthday wish or a plan-ending reminder, when, or why someone did not.
expected: A record per reminder sent (member, type, day), and a reason when a member was skipped, visible to the owner.
fix_line: Have the phone report each reminder it shows, and list them for the owner

title: Reminder screen says every app member gets them, but many app members cannot
what: The screen says 'Members with the MettleUp app get these'. The server gives the birthday, joining day and last visit only to a member whose number was matched at a QR check-in, whose first name matches and whose number is not shared. An app member who never checked in by QR gets no birthday, welcome, one-year or we-miss-you reminder.
expected: Words that match the rule, for example 'Members who have the app and have checked in once with the gym's QR'.
how_often: every app member without a matched QR check-in
fix_line: Say the real condition on the screen

title: Today and the AI ask the owner to send birthday and renewal messages the app already sends
what: Today shows '3 birthdays today' and '5 plans end this week' with a link to send WhatsApp messages, and the AI suggests 'Write birthday wishes' and 'Write a renewal reminder'. Neither checks whether the automatic birthday or plan-ending reminder is on (both are on by default), so members with the app get the same wish twice.
expected: When the automatic reminder is on, the nudge counts only members it will not reach, or says the app already wished them.
how_often: every birthday or plan end where the owner follows the nudge
fix_line: Let Today and the AI read the automatic reminder switches and leave out members already covered

title: Who was already messaged on WhatsApp is remembered only on one device
what: When going down a group on WhatsApp, the list of who is done is kept only in that browser. If the owner and the front desk (or a phone and a laptop) work the same list, each starts from the top and members get the same message twice. The member's page does not show it was sent either.
expected: The done list kept on the gym server, shared by every staff device, and shown on the member's page.
how_often: whenever two staff devices send the same message
fix_line: Keep the sent list on the server for the whole gym

title: Two alert-wording server changes are in the code folder but marked not live
what: The alert words for trainer questions and online trials are patched in the admin app and in HQ's push sender because the server changes that write the new words are noted as NOT LIVE. The repo carries them as if applied.
expected: Either apply them or mark them clearly as waiting, and list them in the live-state table.
fix_line: Apply the two pending server changes or record them as waiting

title: iPhone members get no pop-ups at all, but the admin app promises every app member gets them
what: The member app's own notes say every notification of the app is still off on iPhone. The admin app tells the owner 'Members with the MettleUp app get these on their phone at 9:30 am' for automatic reminders and counts every app member as reached for messages, with no word about iPhones.
expected: The admin app says iPhone members do not get pop-ups yet, and the reach counts leave them out or mark them.
how_often: every iPhone member; cannot be proven in the cloud, needs a real-phone check
fix_line: Tell owners iPhone members get no pop-ups yet, or turn them on

title: A member who never matched at a QR check-in silently gets no gym plan and no workout of the day
what: When the gym answers 'see the desk' (no QR check-in yet, or the first name does not match), the app saves nothing and shows no card, with no reason. The trainer's screen only says in general that members see plans after one check-in; it does not show, for the member a plan is sent to, that this member will not get it.
expected: The member sees why (check in once at the desk), and the trainer sees per member whether the plan will arrive.
how_often: every member not yet matched by QR check-in
fix_line: Show the reason on the phone and a per-member 'will get it' mark for the trainer

title: After a gym drops from Pro, plans on members' phones freeze without a word
what: The phone stops asking for gym plans when the gym's plan lacks trainer plans. Plans already on the phone stay labelled as sent by the gym, are never updated, and a plan the trainer withdraws is never relabelled 'No longer sent'. Neither the member nor the owner is told.
expected: The phone labels the plans as no longer updated, and the owner is told what members lose when the plan ends.
how_often: only once the plan switch is on and a gym drops from Pro
fix_line: Relabel gym plans when the gym loses the feature and say so

title: The phone says the watch buzzes on time, without knowing the watch's own alarm setting
what: The phone's rest-alert line says 'Your phone and watch buzz when rest is over' from the phone's settings only. The watch turns off the phone's copy of 'Rest is over' and relies on its own alarm, which quietly falls back to a late alarm when the watch's 'Alarms & reminders' is off and the watch screen is not showing the app.
expected: The phone's line reflects the watch's alarm state too, or the watch's late-alarm state is shown on the phone.
how_often: cannot be proven in the cloud, needs a real-phone check
fix_line: Send the watch's alarm state to the phone and show it in the rest-alert line

title: Nightly clean-up, billing and staff-alert jobs leave no record HQ can open
what: The nightly backup writes a status HQ and the watch can read, but the nightly clean-up, the nightly billing job (plan downgrades), the every-minute staff alerts and the member pop-up runs only write a line to the server log. If one fails, or is switched off because a setting is missing, HQ sees nothing.
expected: Each automatic job writes its last run, result and any failure where HQ's Needs you can show it, like the backup does.
how_often: whenever a job fails or is not set up
fix_line: Store each job's last result like the backup status and show failures on HQ

title: The weekly free-limit check looks the same when it could not run as when all is fine
what: Once a week HQ checks Cloudflare's daily request count and shows one line only when usage passed 60 or 80 percent. If the token is missing or Cloudflare cannot be reached, it writes only a log line, so HQ's Needs you stays empty exactly as it does when usage is low.
expected: A 'free-limit check could not run' line on HQ when the check fails.
fix_line: Show a line on HQ when the check itself fails

title: Older member apps still pop up messages the gym meant to be quiet
what: From a gym's third message of the day, members should get no pop-up. Member apps older than the first release after 0.60.0 do not know the quiet mark, so their own 15-minute check still pops every message up. There is no push for those members to update.
expected: Old apps are asked to update, or the server leaves quiet messages out of what old apps fetch.
how_often: members on old app versions; cannot be proven in the cloud, needs a real-phone check
fix_line: Leave quiet messages out of old apps' pop-up check

title: A phone pop-up that fails to send is never tried again
what: The sender moves past each batch of phones before sending, so a pop-up that Google refuses for a moment is counted as failed in the log and never retried. The member only finds the message at the app's own 15-minute check, and nobody can see who missed the pop-up.
expected: Failed sends retried once, or counted on the message so the owner can see how many pop-ups went.
how_often: only when Google answers with an error for a phone
fix_line: Retry failed pop-ups once in the next run
